supportedClaims: Persisted Pauli dynamical Lie algebra evidence with independent nested-commutator closure (<=4 qubits, <=64 generators), dense AB-BA cross-check (<=3 qubits) and central Acceptance.
outOfScope: Abstract isomorphism proofs of upstream Lie algebra labels, finite-depth ansatz expressibility, trainability, pulse reachability or hardware controllability.
Independent closure proof beyond 4 qubits or 64 Pauli generators, or dense commutator verification beyond 3 qubits.

checks.criterion: Persisted generator request satisfies its JSON Schema.
Persisted Lie algebra result satisfies its JSON Schema.
All Pauli generators are distinct, nonidentity and match numQubits.
Reported reference mode binds to the requested referenceMode.
When within <=4 qubits and <=64 generators, independent nested commutator closure agrees with reported DLA dimension.
Full su(2^n) dimension 4^n - 1 and generatesFullSpecialUnitary flag agree with independent closure.
When explicit closure is returned, basis elements are distinct nonidentity Hilbert-Schmidt orthogonal Pauli words.
When explicit closure is returned within <=4 qubits, it exactly equals the independent nested commutator closure.
Returned closure contains every generator and is closed under all pairwise commutators.
Reported center dimension matches the centralizer of the independent closure.
When the Tool reports a computed dense reference, its dimension and residual agree with independent closure.
For <=3 qubits, complex dense AB - BA commutators independently agree with every symplectic closure bracket.
Every performed independent check is non-failing; optional reference availability cannot hide a scientific contradiction.
Actual re-read canonical input and artifact bytes match their digests and actual Harness event range.
